- Repair goes straight to Citation repair.

`cp /work/app/.worktrees/config-loader/doc/plans/2026-03-02-config-loader.md /tmp/gauntlet-resume-plan-2026-03-02-config-loader.md.bak`
This saves the pre-loop bytes outside the repository. The call succeeds.

- Insert `` `schema.json` `` into the body of Task 2.
- Insert `` `--config` `` and `` `CONFIG_PATH` `` into the body of Task 3.

These are file edits to `/work/app/.worktrees/config-loader/doc/plans/2026-03-02-config-loader.md`, and they succeed.

`plan_check({ planPath: "/work/app/.worktrees/config-loader/doc/plans/2026-03-02-config-loader.md" })`

- The plan was dirty before the loop, so there is **no commit and no `git add`**.

- The temp copy is not restored, because there was no stop.
